response.overview: A hardened state that inscribes itself into bodies. Fascinating and tormenting at once. In search of queer liberation, we walk along the memories of the director. To the places where he grew up in the countryside. He wants to go back, but he cannot. Past idyllic landscapes and frozen waters, towards communities that promise something to hold onto. And so we move, step by step, between reality and fiction, to a place that finally holds him.
response.title: The Headgear
